name: 344. A Vertex batch line's custom_id that cannot be a request label is encoded, or refused when too long (vertex batch custom_id)
description: Contract C8 (TXE-6971): a Vertex Gemini batch line has no native custom_id, so the gateway carries it in request labels, whose values hold at most 63 lowercase letters, digits, underscores and dashes. A custom_id that is a label value travels as it is in bifrost_custom_id; any other (an uppercase letter, a dot, more than 63 characters) is base32-encoded across bifrost_custom_id_b32_<n> labels and decoded on results, so it comes back unchanged and never reaches Vertex as a label its rules forbid. A custom_id that has to be encoded and is longer than 256 bytes is refused with a 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming requests[i].custom_id before anything is uploaded. The case here is answered by the gateway alone, with no vendor call. The round trip itself is pinned by the Go test TestVertexBatchCustomIDRoundTripsThroughLabels: a live pin would need a batch run to completion.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] vertex vertex batch custom_id: a custom_id too long to carry is refused naming the line, before anything is uploaded
